title: Agent Manifest
description: Contract for agents/<agent-name>/agent.yaml. One manifest describes exactly one business agent: its identity, its owning team, the model it runs on, the tools it may call, its hard runtime limits, and where its tests live. The manifest is a versioned artifact; it changes only through a pull request.

name.description: Agent identifier in lower kebab case. It must be identical to the directory name under agents/, because the runtime resolves the agent from the directory it was loaded from.

version.description: Semantic version of the agent definition. Bump the patch for prompt or tool changes, the minor for additive capability, the major for a breaking contract change.

owner.description: Owning team handle in lower kebab case, for example research-platform. The handle must appear in CODEOWNERS.

description.description: One-line statement of what the agent does and for whom. Plain text, no trailing period required.

model.description: Model selection applied to every run of this agent unless a run overrides it through an approved policy bundle.

provider.description: Model provider identifier, for example openai, anthropic, azure-openai, bedrock, vertex, or internal.

name.description: Model identifier as the provider names it, for example gpt-5-codex. Never a URL and never a credential.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Analytical agents stay at or below 0.3; creative drafting may go higher.

tools.description: Tools the agent may call. Every name must resolve to a contract under schemas/tool-contracts/ or to an implementation under the agent's own tools/ directory. A tool that is not listed here must be denied by the policy engine at call time.

limits.description: Hard runtime bounds. The runtime stops a run that exceeds either bound and records the stop as a run event.

max_steps.description: Maximum number of agent steps (model calls plus tool calls) in a single run.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock duration of a single run, in seconds.

tests.description: Repository-relative paths to the agent's test suites, for example tests/unit or tests/eval/smoke.yaml. The verification skill reads this list to decide what to run for a change to this agent.
